## Documentation

Contains the result of gift crafting.

### Parameters

- **`type`** ([`CraftGiftResultType`](../../enums/CraftGiftResultType.md))
  Type of the result.

- **`gift`** ([`Gift`](Gift.md), *optional*)
  The crafted gift.
  For `SUCCESS` results only.

- **`owned_gift_id`** (`str`, *optional*)
  Unique identifier of the crafted gift for the current user, as accepted by the methods that manage owned
  gifts (e.g. [`set_gift_resale_price`](../../methods/payments/set_gift_resale_price.md)).
  For `SUCCESS` results only.

- **`retry_after`** (`int`, *optional*)
  Time left before the gift can be used for crafting, in seconds.
  For `TOO_EARLY` results only.
